exports: pub fn validate_base64(input: &[u8], policy: Base64Policy) -> FormatResult<u32>
pub fn validate_hex(input: &[u8], policy: HexPolicy) -> FormatResult<u32>

test_vectors.execution: Not run. The task prohibits cargo, rustc, rustfmt, and all build/check commands. Source and test vectors were reviewed by reading the files only.
implementation_properties: Frozen shared types and signatures are used without modifying the crate root or ABI.
Both validators run in linear time with constant auxiliary memory and no allocation, decoding, unsafe code, or additional dependencies.
Base64 byte and padding errors are detected from left to right, followed by incomplete length or missing padding, then nonzero discarded bits.
Hex validates total and exact length before prefix and digit contents; expected encoded lengths use checked usize conversion, multiplication, and addition.
Decoded counts use checked u32 conversion and report Limit at the saturating input-end index on overflow.

cases.coverage: Empty input and f, fo, foo, foob, fooba, foobar encodings; expected counts 0 through 6; padded and unpadded forms under both alphabets and all padding policies.
Standard ++//, /+/+, +w==, /w==, //8= and corresponding URL-safe encodings; cross-alphabet and mixed-alphabet failures with exact indices.
All 256 byte values except structural '=' at each of four positions, for both alphabets and all padding policies.
Leading, embedded, and trailing whitespace, line breaks, NUL, invalid UTF-8 bytes, and UTF-8 nonbreaking space.
Leading padding, padding after one data character, data after padding, excessive padding, unnecessary padding, incomplete padding, and forbidden padding.
Every length from 0 through 129 under all padding policies, including impossible remainder 1 and missing required padding.
All 64 final sextet values for two- and three-character tails, after 0, 4, or 8 complete data characters, for both alphabets and every applicable padded or unpadded policy.
Zh== and Zm9= noncanonical tails; malformed padding and multiple failures verify deterministic error kind and index.
Empty digits, zero and maximum byte encodings, numeric digits, mixed case, lowercase and uppercase restrictions, exact zero length, and prefixed encodings.
All 256 byte values at every position in four digits, with and without prefix, for Any, Lower, and Upper case policies; distinguishes InvalidByte from NonCanonical.
Missing, short, uppercase, malformed, repeated, control-byte, and non-ASCII prefixes; forbidden prefix behavior under every case policy.
Lengths 0 through 66 with and without prefix; exact counts 0, 1, 2, 20, 32, u32::MAX / 2, and u32::MAX; confirms invalid lengths precede invalid contents.
Whitespace, separators, signs, NUL, invalid UTF-8 and Unicode digits, plus competing case and alphabet errors.
Required 0x prefix and exact 20-byte address or 32-byte hash policies, with truncation, excess digits, and final invalid digits.
Valid and invalid subslices surrounded by sentinel bytes, truncated padding and hex digits, empty subslices, and relative error indices.
Checked expected-length arithmetic, usize overflow, u32::MAX decoded count, count overflow where representable, and explicit u32::MAX error-index saturation without enormous allocations.
